title: Board view, recurring tasks, and CSV exports
intro: A new Acme Tasks update goes live on **[date]**. You don't need to do anything to get it. Once it's out, just refresh the page or reopen the app.

heads_up.title: Heads up: two things work differently

blocks.text: Reminders now arrive the morning a task is due

items: Due-date reminders used to arrive the evening before. They now arrive at **8:00 AM** on the day the task is due.
To pick a different time, open **Settings**, then **Notifications**, and change **Reminder time**.
**Tasks with no due date** no longer send reminders. Add a due date to any task you still want a reminder for.

blocks.text: You can still open and search them. To edit one, choose **Restore project** first.

A new **Board** view sits next to **List**. It shows tasks as cards in columns that you can drag between. It opens in List on your phone and Board on your computer, and it remembers whichever one you pick.

blocks.caption: Board view on your computer

images.alt: A project in Board view on a phone
images.caption: Board view on your phone

blocks.text: Open a task, choose **Repeat**, and pick daily, weekly, or monthly. When you complete it, the next one appears on its own.

blocks.alt: The Repeat menu on a task

blocks.text: Open the three-dot menu in the top right of a list and choose **Export to CSV**. The file opens in Excel or Google Sheets.

items: **Faster task entry.** Press **Enter** after adding a task to start the next one right below it.
**Your filters stay put.** On the Tasks list, your search and filters are still there when you open a task and come back.
**Clickable names.** Project names in search results now open the project.
**Quicker loading.** Large projects open a little faster.
The **Completed** filter now shows only completed tasks.
Some tasks showed a due date one day early for people in other time zones. They now show the right day.

closing: If something doesn't look right after the update, just reply to this email and we'll take a look.
